statement: Whenever count_smaller returns a result r, len(r) = n and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, r[i] is the number of indices j such that i < j < n and nums[j] < nums[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: For every slice nums satisfying the preconditions, count_smaller returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever count_smaller returns a result r, len(r) = len(nums).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever count_smaller returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= r[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever count_smaller returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n, r[i] <= n - 1 - i.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever count_smaller returns a result r, the sum of r[0], r[1], ..., r[n - 1] equals the number of pairs (i, j) such that 0 <= i < j < n and nums[j] < nums[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever count_smaller returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n - 1, if nums[i] <= nums[i + 1], then r[i] <= r[i + 1].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever count_smaller returns a result r, for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < n and nums[i] > nums[j], r[i] >= r[j] + 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever count_smaller returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n and every integer v with v < nums[i], r[i] is at least the number of indices j such that i < j < n and nums[j] = v.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000.

statement: Whenever count_smaller returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n - 1, if nums[i] = nums[i + 1], then r[i] = r[i + 1].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10000 <= nums[i] <= 10000.
